pins.name: BROWN
pins.notes: Supply +. Needs 5 to 24 V: use VIN (5 V)

pins.name: BLACK
pins.notes: Phase A. NPN open collector: use INPUT_PULLUP or 4.7 kΩ to 3V3, never to the supply

pins.name: WHITE
pins.notes: Phase B. NPN open collector: pull-up to 3V3 only

pins.name: ORANGE
pins.notes: Phase Z (one pulse per turn). NPN open collector: pull-up to 3V3 only

pins.name: SHIELD
pins.notes: Leave unconnected or tie to GND
